name: secret-field
title: Secret Field
description: Read-only secret display that keeps the readable prefix (sk_live_, ghp_) and last characters, flags Live or Test keys, re-masks on a timer or when the tab is hidden, and makes copying the masked text put the real key on the clipboard.

meta.stops: Masked API key pasted as dots
meta.summary: Shows an API key masked but recognisable, re-hides it on a timer or when the tab is hidden, and copies the real value instead of dots.
meta.server: Show full secrets only once at creation if you can, and support rotation and revocation server-side.
catches: Live versus test keys from the prefix (sk_live_, pk_test_…)
Masked text copied by hand, replaced with the real value on the clipboard
Revealed keys left on screen, re-masked after autoHide (default 10 s)
Tab switches while revealed, re-masked on visibilitychange
limits: The full secret is still in the page's JavaScript and React props; masking is visual
Clipboard contents are outside its control once copied (clipboard managers, sync)
Prefix detection covers common formats only
a11y: Visible <label> on a read-only input; masked state exposed via aria-description "Hidden"
Reveal is an aria-pressed toggle with aria-controls and a changing aria-label
Copy button has an aria-label; copy result announced in a polite live region
